name: Civil Engineering
boundaries: Civil Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Intrinsic autonomous self-healing in bulk structural concrete
original_dispositions.reason: Repeated recovery of structural capacity is preserved. Wider-crack sealing is a demonstrated component; the 200-year life and lifecycle-carbon cut were not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal predictive model of long-term concrete durability
original_dispositions.reason: Forecasting would improve design margins but would not itself stop deterioration or create a new structural capability at the calibration scale. The less-than-5% error threshold was not found in an inspected source.

Narrowed to default-cost reinforcement with carbon-steel structural and fire behavior and specialty-product corrosion performance in specified exposures. Existing stainless and polymer bars are current state.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete liquefaction theory plus universal mitigation
original_dispositions.reason: Prediction of triggering and consequences and in-place ground conversion remain separate. Zero failures and any soil overstate both demonstrations.
Narrowed to fail-safe adaptive primary structural response. CIV-09 can also be achieved through passive means; city-scale cloaking was not added, and supplemental devices are current state.

original_dispositions.original_title: Carbon-negative binding chemistry from abundant waste streams
original_dispositions.reason: The preserved claim is zero process CO2 at Portland scale and price. Net sequestration is a further breakthrough, and waste-stream feedstock limits prevent a separate entry.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal prevention of progressive collapse in any typology
original_dispositions.reason: Mitigation practice exists, present rules have scope limits, and impossibility for every damage and typology was not considered a single discovery of the required kind.
Perpetual pavement already aims at more than 50 years without major structural reconstruction, with surface renewal. Ending renewal everywhere was judged an incremental extension.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scalable instantaneous construction of entire code-compliant structures
original_dispositions.reason: Printing, modules, and robotics change production speed; missing pieces lie in machine systems, site logistics, or the identified materials claims. No separate civil principle was found.

original_dispositions.original_title: One integrated multi-hazard system for coastal and riverine infrastructure
original_dispositions.reason: The hazards do not share one missing material or theory. Relevant pieces remain in the listed concepts, and packaging them together counts consequences needing separate breakthroughs.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Initial compilation, 1 November 2026: ten candidates selected against the calibration set, with partial achievements recorded as current state.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Preserve the first-pass concepts and distinguish partial results from completed capabilities.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Reconciliation pass, 1 November 2026: every first-pass concept and ID retained; none deleted, replaced, or merged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: CIV-01 distinguishes net-negative sequestration and waste-only feedstocks; CIV-02 and CIV-03 separate prediction from treatment; CIV-04 distinguishes wider-crack sealing from capacity recovery and removes unsupported service-life and carbon figures; potentially confused routes are cross-referenced.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added default-cost reinforcement with carbon-steel behavior and corrosion performance of specialty products.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The revised standard treats a radical change in cost and accessibility as qualifying. Existing stainless and polymer products remain current state, and the NACE figure is confined to all-sector corrosion.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added fail-safe adaptive primary structural response, narrowed from the historical adaptive metamaterial wording.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Supplemental semi-active devices are achieved components; city-scale cloaking remains rejected. The 2025 Dharmajan and AlHamaydeh review is the status source.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The historical list’s five purported official citations were not used as evidence.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The ASCE vision URL returned a 404, the NAE page described the original fourteen challenges rather than this list, and the other three cited special issues were not confirmed.
